title: Cinematic Staging
description: Rich environmental sensory anchors, physical props, and unspoken subtext.
systemPromptDirective: Ground the narrative in vivid sensory texture and physical interaction with environment and props.

fields.label: Setting & Atmosphere
fields.placeholder: e.g., Subterranean cantina at 3 AM; acid rain against neon glass
fields.helperText: Sensory mood, weather, architecture, and lighting

fields.label: Sensory Details
fields.placeholder: e.g., Smell of ozone, hum of cooling fans, flickering amber terminal
fields.helperText: Sounds, smells, textures, and ambient temperatures

fields.label: Key Props & Blocking
fields.placeholder: e.g., Cracked cipher chip, unlit cigarette, service pistol on table
fields.helperText: Physical objects characters handle, touch, or exchange

fields.label: Subtext & Unspoken Tension
fields.placeholder: e.g., Neither character mentions the bounty placed on Marcus
fields.helperText: Underlying motivations, secrets, or what remains unsaid

fields.label: The Turn / Twist
fields.placeholder: e.g., The transmission is revealed to be a syndicate tracking ping
fields.helperText: The unexpected shift or pivot in the scene's momentum
